options.name: Now
options.line: KVELD, a thin bar and a counter on black, then a fade into the room.

options.name: Tuning Up
options.line: Six strings across the dark, plucked and lit one by one as the page loads. Then all six are strummed and the room comes up through them.

options.name: First Line
options.line: Floe's outline drawn from its plan in one line, its measurements ticking in. Then the line flares and lets go.

options.name: Halo
options.line: The hero's arch of light draws itself round. Then it opens and the room appears through it.
